Jeb Bush Embraces The Big Lie On Medical Marijuana With Full Frontal Stupidity

(Marijuananews note: This is from a campaign speech, so perhaps it should not be taken too seriously as to actual intent, especially after the victories of the various medical marijuana initiatives.

However, it displays such a degree of ideological commitment and isolation from reality that these victories may have just deepened the paranoia.
See

Confrontated By Florida Medical Marijuana Advocates Former Drug Addicted Drug Czar Makes Total Fool Of Himself  
and
Florida Representative McCollum Introduces Anti-Medical Marijuana Resolution in House of Representatives

Of course, lying about medical marijuana runs in the family, and the Bushes are very big on tradition.
See
3 Former Presidents Again Oppose Medical Marijuana; It Didn’t Work 2 Years Ago

However, it displays such a degree of ideological commitment and isolation from reality that these victories may have just deepened the paranoia.
See

When Jeb’s father was Reagan’s Vice President, he was put in charge of stopping the importation of Colombian marijuana into Florida, which led to the crack cocaine epidemic.

Thanks toAaron Wilson awilson@prdi.org for bringing this to everyone’s attention.)

From Speech "FOUR FRONTS Renewing Florida’s War on Drugs"
By Jeb Bush & Frank Brogan
For the full text – with lots more of the same see
http://www.jeb.org/speeches/speechtopic15.html

(Marijuananews note: This is the national prohibitionist party line. It can be traced back to the efforts of Dan Lungren, who actually sent a California narc to Florida, apparently at California taxpayer expense, to lie about his state.)

Marijuana has not been approved by the FDA to treat any disease or condition, nor has it been recognized by professional medical organizations as a safe or effective medicine.

(Marijuananews note: But it has been approved by the Florida Medical Association!)

Simply put, the medicinal marijuana movement is a stalking horse for drug legalization, and I will work with the Drug-Free America Foundation to ensure that it never becomes the law of the land in Florida.

(Marijuananews note: He is making a political alliance with an organization that is supposedly about "drug education", but which is really a prohibitionist propaganda front for the pharmaceutical industry. Notice that this is a foundation that will be working to oppose a state initiative.)
